---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

I used [Sam Shanny-Csik's documentation](https://github.com/samanthacsik/strava-dashboard/wiki/Creating-a-Strava-API-Application-&-authentication) for getting API access and wrangling the data.


```{r}
# load libraries
library(rStrava)
library(tidyverse)
library(hms)
library(leaflet)
library(googleway)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r}
# authenticate account and create token
my_token <- httr::config(token = strava_oauth(app_name, app_client_id, app_secret,
                                              app_scope = "activity:read_all"))
```

```{r}
# get all activities
my_activities <- get_activity_list(stoken = my_token)

# convert lists of activities into data frame
activities_df <- compile_activities(my_activities)
```

```{r}
# save copy of raw activities data as csv
write_csv(activities_df, "data/raw/strava_activities_raw.csv")
```

```{r}
# cleaning data for leaflet: rename, convert, select, and drop NAs to get only moving activities (my code)
clean_activities <- activities_df %>%
  
  rename(start_lat = start_latlng1,
         start_long = start_latlng2,
         end_lat = end_latlng1,
         end_long = end_latlng2,
         avg_speed = average_speed,
         max_elev = elev_high,
         min_elev = elev_low,
         total_elev_gain = total_elevation_gain) %>%
  
  mutate(upload_id = as.numeric(upload_id),
         pr_count = as.numeric(pr_count),
         athlete.id = as.numeric(athlete.id),
         id = as.numeric(id),
         
         start_datetime = as_datetime(start_date), # yes
         start_datetime_local = as_datetime(start_date_local), # yes
         start_datetime_localSplit = start_datetime_local, # NO
         start_date = date(start_date_local), # yes
         
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "AlpineSki", "Alpine Ski"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "NordicSki", "Nordic Ski"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "RollerSki", "Rollerski"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "Ride", "Bike"),
         type = str_replace(type, "AlpineSki", "Alpine Ski"),
         type = str_replace(type, "NordicSki", "Nordic Ski"),
         type = str_replace(type, "RollerSki", "Rollerski"),
         type = str_replace(type, "Ride", "Bike")) %>%
  
  separate(start_datetime_localSplit, c("Delete", "start_time_local"), sep = " ") %>%
  mutate(start_time_local = parse_hms(start_time_local),) %>%
  
  filter(sport_type != "Workout") %>%
  
  select(!c(contains("heart"), contains("photo"), average_cadence, trainer, private,
            has_kudoed, from_accepted_tag, flagged, commute, resource_state,
            athlete.resource_state, from_accepted_tag, manual, workout_type, Delete, 
            start_datetime, timezone, utc_offset)) %>%
  
  drop_na(start_lat)
```

```{r}
# more datetime cleaning, converting units, changing to factors (code from Sam Shany-Csik)
clean_activities <- clean_activities %>%
  
  rename(start_datetime = start_datetime_local,
         start_time = start_time_local) %>%
  
  mutate(avg_speed = round((avg_speed * 0.621371), 2),
         distance = round((distance * 0.621371), 2),
         max_elev = round((max_elev * 3.281), 2),
         min_elev = round((min_elev * 3.281), 2),
         total_elev_gain = round((total_elev_gain * 3.281), 2),
         elapsed_time = (seconds_to_period(elapsed_time)),
         moving_time = seconds_to_period(moving_time),
         start_date = as.Date(start_date)) %>% # should have 33 variables total after reordering
  
  mutate_at(c("visibility", "sport_type", "type", 
               "athlete.id", "upload_id_str"), 
            factor) %>%
  
  select(name, sport_type, type, visibility, start_datetime, 
         start_date, start_time, elapsed_time, moving_time, distance,
         avg_speed, max_speed, min_elev, max_elev, total_elev_gain,
         start_lat, start_long, end_lat, end_long, athlete_count, achievement_count, 
         pr_count, kudos_count, comment_count, map.id, map.resource_state, 
         map.summary_polyline, athlete.id, external_id, id, upload_id, upload_id_str)
```

```{r}
# save clean activities data as a csv
write_csv(clean_activities, "data/processed/strava_activities_clean.csv")
```
